description: Sync health, content flow and API usage of the Confluence Connector.

panels.description: Confluence Connector alerts firing right now. Open Alerting to see which.
panels.title: Firing alerts

panels.description: Time since each tenant last finished a sync without an error. Orange after 2 hours, red after 3. Always looks back 24 hours, whatever the selected time range, and shows "none in 24h" when there was no successful sync.

targets.expr: time() - max by (tenant) (last_over_time((timestamp(changes(cfc_sync_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", result="success"}[2m]) > 0))[24h:1m])) or max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="idle"}) * NaN

panels.title: Since last successful sync

panels.description: Connector pods Prometheus can scrape right now. Red at 0.
panels.title: Pods up

panels.description: Memory the busiest pod uses right now, as a share of its container limit. Orange from 70%, red from 90%. The pod is OOM-killed at 100%.
panels.title: Memory, % of limit

panels.description: 99th percentile wait for the Node.js event loop right now, worst pod. Orange from 100 ms, red from 500 ms.
panels.title: Event loop lag (p99)
Totals for the selected time range (${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm} to ${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm})

panels.description: Syncs that finished without an error. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Successful syncs

panels.description: Syncs that stopped with an error. A failed sync ingests nothing. Search the logs for "Sync failed". Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Failed syncs

panels.description: 95% of syncs finished within this time. Orange over 30 minutes, red over an hour. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Sync time (p95)

panels.description: Share of requests to Unique ingestion and scope management that failed. Orange from 0.1%, red from 1%, where the ConfluenceConnectorUniqueAPIErrors alert fires. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Unique API error rate

panels.description: Confluence responses with an error status. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Confluence API errors

panels.description: Container restarts. Orange from 1, red from 3. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Pod restarts

panels.description: Pages sent to Unique. Only new or changed pages are sent. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Pages ingested

panels.description: Pages that failed to reach Unique. They are retried on the next sync. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Pages failed

panels.description: Pages found in Confluence but not ingested: empty pages, pages deleted during the sync, and pages that could not be fetched or read. They are found again, and skipped again, on every sync. Search the logs for "Failed to fetch page". Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Pages skipped

panels.description: Attachments uploaded to Unique. Images inlined into their page are not counted here. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Attachments ingested

panels.description: Attachments that failed to upload. They are retried on the next sync. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Attachments failed

panels.description: Items removed from Unique because they lost their label or were deleted in Confluence. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Content deleted

panels.description: Items that should have been removed from Unique but were not. They stay searchable until a later sync removes them. Counted over the selected time range.
panels.title: Deletions failed

panels.description: One row per tenant. Current phase is what the tenant is doing now. A phase other than Idle for hours means a stuck sync, and every scheduled sync of that tenant is skipped until it ends. Counts cover the selected time range. "Since last successful sync" looks back 24 hours and is empty when there was none.

targets.expr: max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="scanning"}) * 1 + max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="diffing"}) * 2 + max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="ingesting_pages"}) * 3 + max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="ingesting_attachments"}) * 4 + max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="deleting"}) * 5 + max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="cleaning_up"}) * 6

time() - max by (tenant) (last_over_time((timestamp(changes(cfc_sync_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", result="success"}[2m]) > 0))[24h:1m])) or max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="idle"}) * NaN

round(sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_sync_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", result="success"}[$__range]))) or max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="idle"}) * 0

round(sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_sync_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", result="failure"}[$__range]))) or max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="idle"}) * 0

round(sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_pages_processed_total{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", result="success"}[$__range]))) or max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="idle"}) * 0

round(sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_pages_processed_total{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", result="failure"}[$__range]))) or max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="idle"}) * 0

round(sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_pages_processed_total{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", result="skipped"}[$__range]))) or max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="idle"}) * 0

round(sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_attachments_processed_total{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", result="success"}[$__range]))) or max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="idle"}) * 0

round(sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_attachments_processed_total{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", result="failure"}[$__range]))) or max by (tenant) (cfc_sync_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant", phase="idle"}) * 0

panels.title: Tenants (counts for ${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm} to ${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm})

panels.description: Finished syncs per tenant. Each bar covers one time bucket of at least 15 minutes. Red is a failed sync.

defaults.noValue: No syncs finished in this range

panels.title: Syncs per tenant, by result

panels.description: Two lines per tenant, averaged per time bucket of at least 15 minutes. "Total sync": from the start of a sync to its end, including fetching pages, uploading to Unique and deleting removed items. "Finding labelled pages": the first step of the sync, the CQL search in Confluence for pages with the ingest labels, their child pages and their attachments. The gap between the two lines is the time spent comparing with Unique, ingesting and deleting.

defaults.noValue: No syncs finished in this range

targets.expr: sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_sync_duration_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_sync_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_scan_duration_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (tenant) (increase(cfc_scan_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: How long one sync takes, per tenant

panels.description: Items whose state differs from what Unique already has: new, updated, moved or deleted. Only new and updated items are fetched and sent. The same "new" items on every sync are items that are never ingested, usually the skipped pages.

defaults.noValue: No changes found in this range

panels.title: Changes found by the file diff, by type

panels.description: Pages and attachments the latest sync of each tenant had to send to Unique. The value stays until the next sync with changes.
panels.title: Items to ingest in the latest sync

panels.description: Pages per tenant: ingested (success), failed, or skipped. Each bar covers one time bucket of at least 15 minutes.
panels.title: Pages, by result

panels.description: Attachments per tenant: uploaded (success) or failed. Each bar covers one time bucket of at least 15 minutes.
panels.title: Attachments, by result

panels.description: Items removed from Unique, and space folders removed after a space lost all its labelled pages.
panels.title: Deletions from Unique, by result

panels.description: Time to upload one attachment to Unique.

defaults.noValue: No attachments uploaded in this range

panels.title: Attachment upload time (p50, p95)

panels.description: Only tenants with status deleted run this. Shows cleanup runs, and the items and folders they removed from Unique.
panels.title: Deleted tenant cleanup

panels.description: Number of requests the connector sent to Confluence in each 5-minute bucket (or longer on wide time ranges). Requests only happen while a sync runs. The legend total is every request in the selected time range.

defaults.noValue: No requests to Confluence in this range

panels.title: Requests sent to Confluence, by endpoint

panels.description: 95% of Confluence requests to each endpoint finished within this time.
panels.title: Confluence response time (p95), by endpoint

panels.description: Error responses by HTTP status class, and throttling events where the connector reached its own apiRateLimitPerMinute and queued requests.

defaults.noValue: No errors or throttling in this range

panels.title: Confluence errors and throttling

panels.description: Number of requests to Unique ingestion and scope management in each 5-minute bucket (or longer on wide time ranges). Not split by tenant: the client labels every tenant the same. The legend total is every request in the selected time range.
panels.title: Requests sent to Unique, by operation

panels.description: Failed Unique requests. GraphQL errors arrive with HTTP 200, so the status is the code from the error body, for example 400 for "Scope not found". "unknown" means the request never got a response, for example a DNS or connection error.
panels.title: Unique errors, by operation and status

panels.description: 95% of Unique requests for each operation finished within this time.
panels.title: Unique response time (p95), by operation

panels.description: Each line is one pod. 1 means up and scraped by Prometheus. A line that stops is a restart, rollout or crash.
panels.title: Pods up

panels.description: Container restarts per pod. Each bar covers one time bucket of at least 15 minutes.
panels.title: Pod restarts

panels.description: Working set per pod, against the container memory limit. The pod is OOM-killed at the limit.
panels.title: Memory usage vs limit

panels.description: CPU cores used per pod. 1 means one full core.
panels.title: CPU usage

panels.description: How long callbacks wait for the Node.js event loop. Sustained values above 100 ms slow down every request.
panels.title: Event loop lag

panels.description: JavaScript heap in use per pod. Steady growth across syncs points to a memory leak.
panels.title: V8 heap used
